D/ [FL MAX THEODORA AVG] ; R/ PIETAS ROMANA

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Theodora (337-341), Pietas Romana issue of 337-350, on a small round flan; Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust coiffed and draped right, large eye. Obverse inscription: [FL MAX THEODORA AVG]. Reverse description: Pietas standing facing suckling large child. Reverse inscription: PIETAS ROMANA. In exergue: possibly PR[?]. Diameter: 13.3mm, Weight: 0.87gms, die axis: 12
